# Credit support annex (`csa` v1)

Collateral terms: thresholds, minimum transfer, eligible collateral and haircuts.

**Group:** Collateral and margin · **Mnemonic:** `CSA` · **Identifiers:** `CSA-…` in `csaId`

Open one with `CSA <id>`.

version: 1
description: "Collateral terms: thresholds, minimum transfer, eligible collateral and haircuts."

  - { label: Threshold (them), bind: $.thresholdThem, fmt: compact }
  - { label: MTA, bind: $.mta, fmt: compact }

  - { label: MPoR, bind: $.mpor, emphasis: true }
panels:

    title: Eligible collateral and haircuts
